body.objective: Add typed dependency semantics for outcome-safe scientific consumers. The current fold treats only DONE/RETIRED as dependency satisfaction, but many research gates must consume either a constructive result or a certified obstruction. Coordinators currently avoid stranding by removing dependencies and relying on prose plus one-lease ordering, which weakens the machine-checkable DAG and can make a consumer prematurely pullable.
body.stop_condition: Extend the work-item IR with an explicit per-dependency mode such as SUCCESS_TERMINAL versus ANY_TERMINAL, or equivalent typed edges. SUCCESS_TERMINAL must preserve current DONE/RETIRED behavior. ANY_TERMINAL must become satisfied by DONE, OBSTRUCTED or RETIRED, but never ACTIVE, BLOCKED, PROPOSED, a missing event, an expired lease or SHORTFALL. Render the mode and terminal disposition in work-package, work-show, work-ready, overview and derived graphs. Refuse ambiguous mixed legacy/new encodings. Add deterministic regressions for a two-producer comparison gate where one producer proves a no-go, both scientific outcomes become terminal, the comparison becomes READY exactly once, and the same graph remains blocked when either producer has only a missing-dependency SHORTFALL. Provide a migration path for existing outcome-safe input-pinned tickets without rewriting their history.
body.forbid: no global change making every OBSTRUCTED dependency satisfied; no inference from objective prose; no treating BLOCKED or SHORTFALL as terminal evidence; no automatic scientific selection based on disposition; no rewriting existing work items or events; no weakening one-lease discipline or fail-closed missing-dependency behavior
notes: Live motivating case: Candidate A and Candidate B each have a scientifically valid no-go branch, while their A/B comparison must consume either terminal result. A success-only depends_on edge can strand the comparison; removing the edges makes it pullable too early.
Observer and classical outcome-safe reserves currently use input pinning and prose to work around the same limitation.
This should compose with the existing append-only event fold and queue forecasting rather than introduce another scheduler.
